🏠 MAINTENANT  —  dernier état connu de la voiture

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT name FROM cars WHERE id = $car_id), 'Ma Tesla') AS "Nom",
  (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(concat_ws(' ', 'Model', model, CASE WHEN trim_badging IS NOT NULL THEN '· ' || trim_badging END)), 'Model'), '')
     FROM cars WHERE id = $car_id) AS "Modèle",
  
CASE
  WHEN (SELECT end_date IS NULL AND start_date > now() - interval '1 day' FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1) THEN '🚗 En route'
  WHEN (SELECT end_date IS NULL AND start_date > now() - interval '2 days' FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1) THEN '🔌 En charge'
  ELSE (SELECT CASE state::text WHEN 'asleep' THEN '💤 Endormie' WHEN 'online' THEN '☀️ Éveillée' ELSE '📴 Hors ligne' END
        FROM states WHERE car_id = $car_id ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1)
END || ' · depuis ' || (SELECT CASE WHEN s < 3600 THEN round(s / 60) || ' min' WHEN s < 86400 THEN round(s / 3600) || ' h' ELSE round(s / 86400) || ' j' END
  FROM (SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - start_date) AS s FROM states WHERE car_id = $car_id ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1) x) AS "État",
  (SELECT battery_level FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND battery_level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Batterie", (SELECT ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Autonomie",
  (SELECT outside_temp FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND outside_temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Extérieur", (SELECT inside_temp FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND inside_temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Habitacle",
  (SELECT odometer FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND odometer IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Odomètre",
  (SELECT split_part(version, ' ', 1) FROM updates WHERE car_id = $car_id ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Version",
  (SELECT CASE WHEN d.end_date IS NULL THEN 'Sur la route' ELSE COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood))) END FROM drives d
     LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = d.end_address_id LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = d.end_geofence_id
     WHERE d.car_id = $car_id ORDER BY d.start_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Lieu",
  (SELECT CASE WHEN s < 86400 THEN 'il y a ' || round(s / 3600) || ' h' ELSE 'il y a ' || round(s / 86400) || ' j' END || ' · ' || lvl || ' %'
     FROM (SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - COALESCE(end_date, start_date)) AS s, end_battery_level AS lvl FROM charging_processes
           WHERE car_id = $car_id AND charge_energy_added > 0 ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1) x) AS "Dernière recharge"

options.content: 📅 CE MOIS-CI  —  depuis le 1er du mois

targets.rawSql:
WITH dr AS (SELECT d.*, car.efficiency FROM drives d JOIN cars car ON car.id = d.car_id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.start_date >= date_trunc('month', timezone('$__timezone', now()))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL),
ch AS (SELECT cp.* FROM charging_processes cp WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.start_date >= date_trunc('month', timezone('$__timezone', now()))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0)
SELECT (SELECT sum(distance) FROM dr) AS "Distance", (SELECT count(*) FROM dr) AS "Trajets",
  (SELECT sum((start_${preferred_range}_range_km - end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * efficiency) * 100 / nullif(sum(distance), 0) FROM dr) AS "Conso",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ch) AS "Recharges", (SELECT sum(charge_energy_added) FROM ch) AS "kWh", (SELECT sum(cost) FROM ch) AS "Coût"

SELECT to_char(timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', d.start_date)), 'DD/MM HH24:MI') || ' · ' || COALESCE(sg.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(sa.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', sa.road, sa.house_number), '')), COALESCE(sa.city, sa.neighbourhood))) || ' → ' || COALESCE(eg.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(ea.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', ea.road, ea.house_number), '')), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.neighbourhood)))
  || ' · ' || round(d.distance::numeric, 1) || ' km · ' ||
  round(((d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * car.efficiency * 100 / nullif(d.distance, 0))::numeric, 1) || ' kWh/100 km' AS "Résumé"
FROM drives d JOIN cars car ON car.id = d.car_id
  LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
  LEFT JOIN geofences sg ON sg.id = d.start_geofence_id LEFT JOIN geofences eg ON eg.id = d.end_geofence_id
  LEFT JOIN positions sp ON sp.id = d.start_position_id LEFT JOIN positions ep ON ep.id = d.end_position_id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT to_char(timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', cp.start_date)), 'DD/MM HH24:MI') || ' · ' || COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood))) || ' · ' ||
  cp.start_battery_level || ' → ' || cp.end_battery_level || ' % · ' || round(cp.charge_energy_added, 1) || ' kWh'
  || COALESCE(' · ' || round(cp.cost, 2) || ' €', '') AS "Résumé"
FROM charging_processes cp LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0 ORDER BY cp.start_date DESC LIMIT 1
